comment: One folder = one CI route. The first matching rule wins; a path that matches no rule runs the full matrix. scripts/test_ci.py requires every tracked file to match a rule. '*' stays inside one directory, '**' crosses directories.

routes.docs: Documentation text only: the light Documentation and site checks, no Cargo build.
routes.site: Roadmap and site generator (site/): the light Documentation and site checks, no Cargo build.
routes.full: Engine, tooling, workflows, verification data and anything else: the full Windows and Linux matrix.
